text: 中国证监会主席吴清9月7日在京会见了沙特投资部助理大臣穆巴拉克（Ibrahim bin Yousef Al-Mubarak）。双方就加强中沙资本市场合作、促进双向投资等议题交换了意见。
text_en: CSRC Chairman Wu Qing met with Saudi Arabia's Assistant Minister of Investment Ibrahim bin Yousef Al-Mubarak in Beijing on September 7. The two sides exchanged views on strengthening China-Saudi capital market cooperation and promoting two-way investment.
